name: Workshop Hub Online Booking Form
author: workshophub

sections.description:
Add a free online booking form built for mechanics, auto repair shops and car service businesses to any WordPress page. Customers tap a picture service button, pick a real available time, choose extras, enter rego / make / model and contact details — and you get an email for every booking.

Unlike generic appointment calendars (Amelia, Bookly, LatePoint and similar), this form is made for workshops: vehicle fields, service picture buttons, and availability from your Workshop Hub diary. Built in Australia and works for workshops anywhere.

Who it is for

  • Mechanics and independent auto repair workshops
  • Auto electricians and tyre shops
  • Detailers, window tinters and mobile mechanics
  • Any shop that takes service bookings online

What you get

  • Picture service buttons – customers pick the job at a glance (swap images from your Media Library)
  • Real availability – date and time slots from your Workshop Hub calendar
  • Extras – optional add-ons during booking
  • Vehicle details – registration, make and model
  • Contact capture – name, phone, email and notes
  • Block, shortcode or widget – Gutenberg block, [workshop_hub_booking], or classic widget
  • Self-sizing iframe – the form grows with each step (no inner scrollbars)
  • No tracking – the plugin sets no cookies and shows no admin ads

Free form, optional diary

The online booking form is free. Bookings are emailed to you. If you use Workshop Hub workshop software (from $59/mo + GST), those same bookings can land straight in your diary — you do not need a paid plan to run the form.

Don’t have a form yet? Get one free — it takes about two minutes.

External services

This plugin embeds a booking form hosted by Workshop Hub (Driven Autocare Pty Ltd trading as Workshop Hub), which is needed for the plugin to work.

  • What is loaded: pages that show the form load an iframe from https://portal.workshophub.com.au/t/<your-form-id>/book. The default service pictures are loaded from https://portal.workshophub.com.au/booking-defaults/.
  • What is sent and when: when a visitor views a page with the form, their browser requests the form from Workshop Hub (sending standard request data such as IP address and user agent). If you chose custom pictures, the public URLs of those images are included in the form address. When a visitor submits a booking, the details they enter (name, contact details, vehicle, preferred time and notes) are sent to Workshop Hub so the booking can be passed to your workshop.
  • Nothing is sent from your WordPress admin and the plugin does not track your visitors.

Workshop Hub Terms of Service and Privacy Policy.

Credits

Default picture button images are original illustrations owned by Workshop Hub and are served by the hosted form; they are not included in this plugin. The plugin’s banner and icon use the Workshop Hub logo and colours (trademarks of Driven Autocare Pty Ltd).
sections.installation:
1. In WordPress go to Plugins → Add New, search for “Workshop Hub Online Booking Form” and click Install, then Activate. (Or upload the zip under Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin.)
  2. If you don’t have a booking form yet, sign up free at workshophub.com.au/free-online-booking-form and confirm your email.
  3. Go to Settings → Workshop Hub Booking and paste your embed code, booking link or form ID. Save.
  4. Add the “Workshop Hub Booking Form” block, the [workshop_hub_booking] shortcode or the widget to a page.
sections.faq:
Does it cost anything?

No. The online booking form and this plugin are free. Workshop Hub also offers paid workshop management software (from $59/mo + GST) so bookings can land in your diary, but you do not need it to use the form — free form bookings are emailed to you.

Do I need a Workshop Hub account?

Yes — a free booking-form account. Sign up at workshophub.com.au/free-online-booking-form, confirm your email, then paste your form ID into Settings → Workshop Hub Booking.

Where do bookings go?

To your Workshop Hub account. You get an email for each new booking. With a paid Workshop Hub plan, bookings can also appear in your workshop diary.

Does it work with Gutenberg, Elementor and Divi?

Yes. Use the Gutenberg block in the block editor, or drop the [workshop_hub_booking] shortcode into an Elementor Shortcode widget, a Divi Code / Shortcode module, or any page builder that supports shortcodes. A classic widget is also included.

Is it mobile friendly?

Yes. The form is designed for phones first and works on tablet and desktop.

What about privacy / GDPR?

The plugin itself sets no cookies and does not track visitors. Booking data is processed by Workshop Hub when someone submits the form — see Workshop Hub’s Privacy Policy. You remain responsible for your own site privacy notice.

Where do I find my form ID?

It’s in the embed code emailed to you after sign-up (data-workshop="your-form-id") and in your booking link portal.workshophub.com.au/t/your-form-id/book. You can paste either — the plugin finds the ID for you.

Can I change the pictures on the buttons?

Yes. Under Settings → Workshop Hub Booking → Picture button images, click “Change image” and pick any image from your Media Library. Your site must use https for custom pictures to show.

Can I show more than one form?

Yes — use [workshop_hub_booking slug="another-form-id"] or set the Form ID in the block’s sidebar.

Can I remove the “Powered by Workshop Hub” link?

The credit link is off by default. Turn it on under Settings → Workshop Hub Booking if you want to show it.
